Packages for analysing flusurvey data

flusurvey-package.Rd

Functions for reading, cleaning and linking the questionnaire responses of FluSurvey, the UK online cohort survey of influenza-like illness, and for estimating incidence and episodes of illness from them.

Details

read_data reads the questionnaire files of one season, extract_data cleans and links the seasons with merge_data, get_incidence estimates incidence and bouts_of_illness groups symptomatic reports into episodes.
